title: World Bloom — With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail! — Episode1 The Curtains Rise On Adventure

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!
meta.Episode: Episode1 — The Curtains Rise On Adventure
meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime's training continues as they each pursue their dreams. When they're called over to SEKAI by Rin and the others one day, they find an expansive new land awaiting them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-Wh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What is this place?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Surprised, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes! Our super secret plan to surprise you guys went off without a hitch!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, we're surprised...
But what is this place? A harbor...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It seems like it...
But I don't remember seeing this in SEKAI until now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This is so so so cool!
Look at the sea! It's so sparkly! And that big boat!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin and Len were the ones who first discovered this place.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and then we decided that all of you had to see it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We apologize for saying it was an emergency. That must've startled you quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No! I mean, yes, it was startling, but I'm so happy you called us over☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, it is strange how this place apparently just appeared overnight...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Strange indeed. Why did it appear? For what purpose?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Good question.
I can't say for sure...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I believe it has something to do with your feelings, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My feelings?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, because this SEKAI was born out of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, any changes that occur in your feelings can conceivably lead to changes occurring here too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That being said, it very rarely happens.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But what's changed?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did you start deeesperately wanting to see the sea?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, not particularly...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, then! Did you really, really get the urge to go on a cruise?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I don't think that's it either... Actually, we went to the beach for that film shoot, so maybe it was lingering somewhere within my subconscious...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In other words, there's no clear reason.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, let's try exploring this area!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We should look around for clues to see how your feelings have changed! Who knows what we'll find?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, yes! I wanna go exploring too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too! Me too!
Let's go see what secrets are hidden in this area☆

rows.Speaker: Rin, Emu & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, wait! Don't run off like that!
We still have no idea what this place is like!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, geez... Running after them puts you in the same category.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I understand their restlessness. I'm also curious to see what's actually here.

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys!
We can board the ship from here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds like fun.
Let's go, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes, let's explore to see what this new area has to offer.
Aboard the Ship

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This is truly a big ship...
And a well-built one at that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm noticing quite a few places where it's been repaired. My guess is that it's been in service for a very long time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which means it's probably been to a lot of different places.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone, look!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Look at what?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This thing Miku and I found while exploring the ship! Check it out!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, isn't this...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
A map.
With several islands charted.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, there's something written in the corner...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It says...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “To the fabled Star Island”...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Star Island...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That's what it says...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's a star-shaped island on the very edge of the map. I believe it's referring to that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He's right. That's so cute! It looks like some sort of snack!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
An island with “star” in its name...
This place intrigues me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Star Island...
And a map that can take you to it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is something the matter, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, well... This map may be strongly connected to the feelings that caused this new area to appear.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Can you elaborate a little further?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This SEKAI was originally born out of your desire to become a star who can bring smiles to people all around the world.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Star Island... This map leading there...
They may be of great significance to this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah... I see what you mean.
Then, we should inspect this map a little more closely and—

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, the wind...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Wind speed recorded at 13 m/s.
A somewhat strong sea breeze.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, the map!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, it flew away.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't just stare!
It's game over if we let it fall into the water.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We need to catch it somehow...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
There's a biiig bird flying up above!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, we don't have time for that right—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, what the...?!
“Big” is putting things far too lightly!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This bird. Isn't it a...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Red feathers that appear to be burning... A long, sharp beak and a wingspan of at least three meters...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I may be mistaken, but it appears to be a mythical creature known as a phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What?! A phoenix...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow☆ It's a real phoenix!
This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But they don't exist in real—
Oh, I guess that doesn't matter in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Get down...!
It's coming right for us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Th-That was scary...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is anyone hurt?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We're okay!
Wait, where'd the map go?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, I forgot!
Where could it have gone...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! Look, everyone! I think it got hooked on that phoenix's wing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-What do we do?
We're gonna lose sight of the phoenix at this rate!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's chase after it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to catch it and retrieve that map...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I agree...
Especially since that map seems to hold the key to understanding why this place appeared.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go!
Operation: Get the Map Back From That Phoenix is a go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's go!
Ready, you guys?!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!
